text:
Megan (CS): Quick thread — Walker Cloud renewal hits next week. They want to add 2 seats + multimodel addon, asking for proration and an expedited PO path.
Raj (AM): Thanks. Do we have the addon SKU and delta this quarter? Need to see if proration is allowed mid-term.
Megan (CS): Addon SKU: RW-MULTI-01. Pricing delta looks like $3,600/yr. Rough proration for 76 days remaining = ~$1,020 credit back to them if we bill tomorrow. Not final.
Paul (Sales): Can we do a one-off amendment and invoice now? If legal signs off we can attach invoice to DocuSign and ship seats.
Kate (Legal): We can do a short amendment. Need delegated signer on file and confirmation of invoice entity. Any vendor code or VAT changes?
Megan (CS): Customer provided PO 45321. They want DocuSign + net45 and asked to switch invoice entity to Walker EU. Procurement asked invoice PDF attached to the envelope.
billing-bot: Reminder — invoice entity change requires signed amendment + valid EU VAT form before billing. Flagging billing hold until docs are complete.
Raj (AM): I'll confirm vendor code and VAT today. If they stick with net45 can we propose 1.5% early-pay discount for 7 days to accelerate payment?
Paul (Sales): Yes, offer 1.5% only if they commit to 12 months on the addon. Megan, can you fold that into the amendment draft?
Megan (CS): Drafted amendment and pushed to legal review: https://docs.redwood.ai/amendments/45321-draft
Kate (Legal): Reviewed and left two comments: (1) delegated signer clause; (2) revenue recognition note for proration. Small language tweaks.
Megan (CS): Sent updated draft to procurement contact (procurement@walkercloud.com) via DocuSign. They requested invoice PDF attachment in the envelope.
billing-bot: DocuSign envelopes will auto-upload attached invoice to billing if you set flag. Use slash command: `/docusign attach-invoice 45321`
Megan (CS): Ran `/docusign attach-invoice 45321` — envelope created (DocuSign ID AB12-XY). Customer completed first signature, procurement signer still outstanding.
Raj (AM): Any ETA from procurement to finish signing?
Megan (CS): Procurement said ~48 hours. Setting renewal risk to "low" but note PO processing might delay seat provisioning by a few days.
Paul (Sales): Ops question — can we provision provisional seats prior to fully executed amendment to avoid onboarding delay?
Kate (Legal): Provisioning before signed amendment is permitted only for staging (no billing). Legal prefers to avoid revenue-affecting provisioning until signed.
Megan (CS): I'll provision staging seats flagged as "no billing/temporary" so their team can start onboarding immediately. Will add a note in the account: "awaiting amendment signature for billing".
billing-bot: Created billing ticket #BILL-7892 for staging provisioning exception and invoice-entity change workflow.
Megan (CS): Next steps: Raj confirms vendor code & VAT, Paul confirms commercial terms (1.5% early-pay if 12mo), Kate finalizes amendment, I chase remaining signer and provision staging seats. I'll follow up tomorrow AM.
Raj (AM): On it, will update by EOD.
Paul (Sales): Thanks team :thumbsup:
Kate (Legal): Thanks everyone, will finalize language tonight.
